clearcutting-slope.alt: Two panels of a hillside that drains into a stream. Left, forest: the canopy shades the stream so it stays cool, and roots and leaf litter hold the soil, so the stream runs clear. Right, after clearcutting: only stumps remain, full sun warms soil and stream, more rain runs off and carries soil into the stream, and nutrients leach away, so the stream is muddy and warmer.
